_about: Events met on '?' nodes. Outcome types are listed in crates/core/src/content.rs (Outcome). Every event needs one option that costs no gold.

events.title: The Wounded Swordsman
events.text: A swordsman sits against a tree, one hand pressed to his side. His purse lies in the grass beside him.

options.label: Bind his wounds (lose 8% health, gain a rare blessing)
options.result: It costs you blood and bandages. He presses a keepsake into your hand before he sleeps.

options.label: Take the purse (gain 45 gold)
options.result: He watches you take it and says nothing.

options.label: Walk on
options.result: You leave him to the road.

events.title: The Roadside Shrine
events.text: A small shrine, still tended. Coins lie in the offering bowl.

options.label: Make an offering (heal 30% health)
options.result: The incense burns down. You feel lighter.

options.label: Take the offerings (even odds: 60 gold, or lose 15% health)

outcomes.win_text: Nobody sees. The bowl is empty and your purse is not.
outcomes.lose_text: The shrine keeper's staff finds your ribs before you see him.

events.title: The Dice Man
events.text: A man rattles three dice in a cup. "Forty on the table," he says, "and a hundred comes back if they like you."

outcomes.win_text: The dice like you. He pays with a sour face.
outcomes.lose_text: The dice do not like you.

options.label: Decline
options.result: He shrugs and rattles the cup at the next traveler.

events.title: The Narrow Road
events.text: The road narrows between two rock walls. Someone is waiting in the gap, and not alone.

options.label: Fight through (an elite fight, with its reward)
Pay the toll
options.result: They count it twice and let you pass.

options.label: Climb around (lose 12% health)
options.result: The cliff path takes skin from your hands and knees.

events.title: The Old Master
events.text: An old master sweeps the courtyard of an empty school. He looks at how you carry your blade and sighs.

options.label: Train until dusk (lose 15% health, gain a rare blessing)
options.result: He is not gentle. By dusk you have learned something.

options.label: Listen a while (gain a common blessing)
options.result: He talks, you listen. Some of it stays.

events.title: The Abandoned Cart
events.text: A cart stands in the road with no horse and no driver. Its load is still roped down.

options.label: Search it (likely 50 gold; it may be bait)

outcomes.win_text: Under the sacking there is a strongbox, and it is not locked.
outcomes.lose_text: The rope is cut from inside. It was bait.

options.label: Leave it
options.result: You give the cart a wide berth.

events.title: The Healer's Hut
events.text: Smoke rises from a hut hung with drying herbs. The healer looks you over without much hope.

options.label: Buy a remedy (heal 50% health)
options.result: It tastes of mud and works at once.

options.label: Rest by the fire (heal 15% health)
options.result: The fire is warm and nobody asks you anything.

events.title: The Effigy Maker
events.text: A woman folds paper figures by lamplight. Each has a face. One of them, you notice, has yours.

options.label: Buy it (one death forgiven)
options.result: She wraps it in red thread. "It dies so you need not. Once."

options.label: Pay in blood (lose 30% health, one death forgiven)
options.result: She takes what she needs with a small knife and is careful about it.

options.label: Refuse
options.result: She puts your face back in the basket with the others.

events.title: The Beggar at the Gate
events.text: A beggar holds out a bowl. His hands are a swordsman's hands.

outcomes.win_text: "Then take this," he says, and shows you one thing, once.
outcomes.lose_text: He thanks you and says nothing more.
